_meta.source: computed from the src/server/*.server.luau builders + src/shared/Models/PachyModelData.luau v1.5, rest (bind) pose
_meta.scale: ALL sizes and positions are PRE-scale = model scale 1 (PachyModelData values). In game the pachy is ScaleTo(2): multiply every size and position by 2 (rotations unchanged). The builders read live part sizes / GetExtentsSize / segment boxes, so they scale linearly, EXCEPT the literals called out per part (Visor panel thickness 0.15; MedStation radius, edge pieces and some heights).
_meta.HdNote: Hd = char:GetExtentsSize().Y = 8.86 at scale 1 (toe bottom y -4.0 to Head_dome3 top y 4.86, HRP space); 17.72 at scale 2. Assumes the rest pose and no other mecha models already built. Hd is read live at build time, so an animated pose (idle crouch) or an already-built Visor field (panels reach y 5.1) shifts it slightly.
_meta.hrpFrame: HumanoidRootPart frame: forward = -Z (head at z -4..-6, tail toward +Z), up = +Y, +X = the dino's RIGHT (Roblox RightVector). Data parts named *L (ArmL, LegL, ShinL, FootL, Head_eyeL) sit at +X = the dino's RIGHT side; *R parts on its LEFT. HookServer v1.4 relies on this (segment ArmL = the real right arm).
_meta.segmentRootFrame: Every segment Root (invisible 0.2 cube at seg.root) has rotation {0,0,1, 0,1,0, -1,0,0} vs the HRP = Angles(0,-90deg,0): Root +X = forward (HRP -Z), Root +Y = up, Root +Z = dino right (HRP +X), Root -X = back. The Root-anchored builders use x = Root +Z (right), y = Root +Y (up), back = x:Cross(y) = Root -X; each takes the segment's visual-part bounding box in Root space ("rootBox", listed per part) and offsets from its centre by its half-extents.
_meta.mechaSideNames: In the mecha builders (ServoDash, BloodVials, Visor goggles) suffix "L" = side -1 = -x = the dino's real LEFT (HRP -X) - the OPPOSITE of the data-part naming. The Ink tank sits on the real left (-x); the Tether drum on the real right (+x); the hook arm on segment ArmL = real right.
_meta.pieceFields: pos / rotDeg = the piece CFrame relative to "anchor" (anchor:Inverse() * piece). rotDeg = degrees for CFrame.Angles(rx,ry,rz) = Rx*Ry*Rz (the same matrix as a three.js Euler with order "XYZ"). posHRP / rotDegHRP = the same piece in HumanoidRootPart space at the rest pose (HRP at the origin). Cylinder = Roblox cylinder: axis along local X, size.x = length, size.y = size.z = diameter (three.js CylinderGeometry is along Y: rotate it -90deg about Z first). Every piece: Massless, CanCollide / CanQuery / CanTouch false; Ink/Tether/Servo/Visor/Vials also CastShadow false, Smooth surfaces.
_meta.mirroredMatrix: ServoDash housings/bells are built with CFrame.fromMatrix(c, x, y, -back), a LEFT-handed (mirrored) basis. rotDeg given for them is the proper rotation with the same Up and Look vectors (Right flipped) - identical for a symmetric box; positions are computed with the real matrix.

hookArm.seg_or_anchor: ArmL (part ArmL_fore; every piece WeldConstraint Part0 = ArmL_fore)
hookArm.builder: src/server/HookServer.server.luau:246 buildProsthesis; hideArm :224; ARM_HIDE :94 remapped to HookArmSide "ArmL" :112-114; setLook :309

derived.frame: base = CFrame.lookAt(elbow, elbow+axis) (world up); piece = base*CFrame.new(at.X*w, at.Y*w, -at.Z*L); cylinders then * Angles(0,90deg,0)

hookArm.notes: Shown while HookLook is true (Species Pachy). With it on, ArmL_fore / _hand / _claw1-3 get Transparency 1 (old value kept in attribute HookArmOrigT, restored when the look goes); ArmL_upper stays. Elbow = the ArmL_fore end nearer ArmL_upper (fore centre + UpVector*Size.Y/2); axis = elbow -> hand side (down-forward, about 59 deg below horizontal at rest). MOVING: the "Hook" sub-model (Shank, Bend, Barb, Point) is hidden on each client by HookFX 1.2 (LocalTransparencyModifier 1) while the claw is out / reeling / returning, shown again when it is home. "Barrel" is invisible (Transparency 1); the flying claw leaves its tip = Barrel.Position + Barrel.LookVector*Size.Z/2 = elbow + axis*0.95L (clawLaunch*). Server aim origin = the ArmL Root position (shotOriginHRP), not the barrel. HookPose 1.2 lifts ArmL level along the shot; the prosthesis follows ArmL_fore. Rotations relative to fore assume the arm was at rest when built (lookAt uses world up). Strap Leather, Spool Fabric, RedRing SmoothPlastic, the rest Metal. Pre-scale; all w / L multiples scale with the model.

derived.formula: w = Hd*0.07, len = Hd*0.1; centre = box centre + x*side*(ext_x + 0.35w) + back*(0.45 ext_back) - y*(0.15 ext_y); frame fromMatrix(c, x, y, -back): local -Z (look) points BACKWARD; bell = housing*CFrame.new(0,0,-0.62 len) (behind it)

servoDash.notes: Static pieces. FX only: Attachment "Exhaust" in each bell at local (0,0,-0.2 len) holds ParticleEmitter "Flame" (EmissionDirection Front = backward; FFF0A0 -> FF9A2E -> C83C14, size Hd*0.063 -> Hd*0.014, speed Hd*1.2-1.8, life 0.12-0.22 s, rate 160) and from v1.1 "Blast" (Emit 45 at the press, size Hd*0.2 -> 0.05, speed Hd*2.4-3.6) + PointLight "Glow" (FF9632, range Hd*0.8) on the bell; Trail "SpeedLine" between bell attachments TrailA (0,+0.3w,0) / TrailB (0,-0.3w,0), white, life 0.35 s. Flame / SpeedLine / Glow on only while ServoDashUntil runs. Ground ring "ServoDashRing" (neon FFD696 cylinder 0.2 thick, 2 -> Hd*2.2 across in 0.35 s, transp 0.2 -> 1) at the ground under the HRP + 0.15.

inkShooter.builder: src/server/InkServer.server.luau:261 buildShoulder (chosen by build :294 while InkShoulderMount is true, the default)

derived.formula: w,h,d = Hd*(0.08,0.10,0.08); centre = box centre + y*(ext_y + 0.45h) - back*(0.55 ext_back) [forward] - x*(0.55 ext_x) [dino left]; frame fromMatrix(c, x, y, back): local -Z = forward; barrel = tank*CFrame.new(0, 0.1h, -(d/2 + len/2)), len = Hd*0.12; muzzle = barrel tip (0,0,-len/2)

inkShooter.notes: On top of the torso box, front part, the dino's real LEFT (HRP -X; the hook is on the right). Window: Material Glass, Transparency 0, ink colour 0B0B12. No moving pieces. Shot origin = Muzzle.WorldPosition (fallback head hitbox, then HRP). FX: InkGlob black ball 1.6 dia (literal, unscaled) flies muzzle -> InkAimEnd at 160 studs/s; splat cylinder 0.2 x 7 x 7 (hidden on a hit) + 30 drops; pitch clamp -20..+25 deg (shoulder mount); aim assist 12 deg.

derived.formula: w,h,d = Hd*(0.09,0.06,0.13); centre = box centre + y*(ext_y + 0.5h) - back*(0.35 ext_back); frame fromMatrix(c,x,y,back) (-Z forward); barrel = base*CFrame.new(0,0.35h,-0.2d)*Angles(35deg,0,0)*CFrame.new(0,0,-len/2), len = Hd*0.16; tip = barrel*CFrame.new(0,0,-0.55 len); drum = base*CFrame.new(0.62w,0,0.15d)

tether.notes: Barrel pitched 35 deg up, pointing forward over the back. Drum (yellow cylinder, axis sideways) on the dino's real RIGHT (+x). No moving pieces (the Tip stays in the barrel). Launch point = Muzzle.WorldPosition (fallback HRP + (0,3,0)). FX: TetherSpike part 0.7 x 0.7 x 3.2 (literal, steel DiamondPlate, yellow ChainTrail) lobs muzzle -> landing point in 0.8 s, peak 22 studs above the higher end; landing ring yellow (FFC832) neon cylinder 0.2 thick growing 2 -> 2*TetherSplash (16) in 0.3 s; RopeConstraint "TetherChain" yellow, thickness 0.3.

derived.formula: w = Hd*0.045, h = Hd*0.13; centre = neck box centre + out*(ext_x + 0.5h + 0.06h), out = x*side; frame fromMatrix(p, back*side, out): local +Y points straight out sideways (long axis horizontal); caps at +-0.52h, nozzle at +0.62h

bloodVials.notes: Shown while BloodRushEnabled (Species Pachy). Glass: Material Glass, Transparency 0.55. MOVING: Blood_<s> level: Size.Y = full*f (full = 0.86h), FluidHinge C0 = CFrame.new(0, -(full - Size.Y)/2, 0) relative to the glass, so it keeps its inner (neck-side, local -Y) end and drains from the tip back to the neck; Transparency 1 when empty. Vial i is full while HeadbuttSacrifices < i; drain 0.3 s, refill 0.6 s. On HeadbuttSacrificeAt the drained vial's Nozzle ParticleEmitter "Spray" (EmissionDirection Top = local +Y = straight out; AA0A1E -> 6E0012, 220/s, speed 18-28, accel (0,-60,0), drag 1.5, size w -> 0.3w, life 0.4-0.8 s) runs 0.45 s.

domeVisor.builder: src/server/VisorServer.server.luau:202 buildGoggles (headFrame :149); field :162 setField; chosen in setLook :260 (VisorGogglesLook default true)

pieces.light: PointLight LensGlow 5FE3FF range Hd*0.4, brightness 2, on only while the field is up
PointLight LensGlow 5FE3FF range Hd*0.4, brightness 2, on only while the field is up

field.radiusFormula: extent(headBox, back) + Hd*0.12, from the head Root-box centre, in the horizontal plane
field.panelFormula: base = fromMatrix(c, x, y, back); panel_i = base*Angles(0, a_i, 0)*CFrame.new(0,0,-R), a_i = -60deg + step*(i-0.5), step = 120/9 deg; width = 2R*tan(step/2)*1.04, height = Hd*0.3 (both scale), thickness 0.15 (literal, NOT scaled)

derived.formula: d = 0.6 ext_y (lens dia), th = max(0.1, Hd*0.02); eye = box centre + y*(0.15 ext_y) - back*(0.3 ext_back) [forward]; disc centre = eye + x*side*(ext_x + th/2); rim shifted -side*0.3th (inward), lens +side*0.2th (outward); frame fromMatrix(pos,x,y,back): cylinder axis = local X = sideways

domeVisor.notes: Goggles worn whenever VisorLook is true. MOVING: the ForceField panels exist only while VisorUntil is in the future (VisorTime 1.5 s, 2 at II): made at the press with Transparency 1 tweened to 0 in 0.1 s; at the end tweened to 1 in 0.2 s and destroyed after 0.22 s (Lab preview: instant, Transparency 0). Each panel: Weld "PanelWeld" to Head.Root, C0 = pos/rotDeg here. LensGlow lights on only while the field shows; character VisorDown = field showing. The +-60 deg arc = BoneCrest's front block cone.

mechaLegs.seg_or_anchor: ShinL / ShinR (part <seg>_shin) and FootL / FootR (part <seg>_meta); WeldConstraint Part0 = that part
mechaLegs.notes: Shown while MechaLegsLook is true. Sizes are multiples of the anchor part's live Size: Cover = shin*(1.25,0.8,1.25) at the shin centre; Piston = shin*(0.22,0.9,0.22) at shin local (0,0,0.75*shin.Z); shin local +Z = HRP +X for BOTH legs, so it sits on the outer side of ShinL but the inner side of ShinR; Vent = meta*(1.15,0.3,1.15) at meta local (0,-0.35*meta.Y,0) (lower end). STEEL 9AA6B8 / DARK 5D6878, Metal. Static (ride the shin/foot animation).

medStation.notes: Not attached to the pachy. Disc = cylinder * Angles(0,0,90deg) (axis vertical). SCALING: Base / Rim / Core sizes and heights use s = char:GetScale() and are listed at s = 1; at s = 2: Base [0.8,7,7] y 0.4, Rim [0.4,8.26,8.26] y 0.2, Core [0.2,3.5,3.5] y 0.84. NOT scaled: MedRadius (12 studs; 18 from tier II), edge pieces [0.5, 0.16, 0.55*2*pi*R/24] at y 0.08, MedWave thickness 0.06 and y 0.12 (start diameter = Base.Size.Y = 3.5*s). Edge_i at a = (i-0.5)/24*360 deg: pos (R cos a, 0.08, R sin a), lookAt along the tangent (-sin a, 0, cos a) -> rotDeg [0, 180-a, 0] (listed for R = 12; 45% gaps). While the owner is outside the circle: edges Transparency 0.6, Core 0.5, Glow off. Lab preview: s = 1, R = 5. Lasts MedTime (5 s; 7 at III; 10 at star).
